notes.title: V106 Update
notes.content:
V106 adds:


 Press down on L stick to toggle first person view. (V on keyboard,)
 When turret is down, orientation is reset.

notes.title: V105: Improved optional gamepad control scheme.
notes.content:
V105

This version has the following fixes:

 When using the alternate gamepad scheme via usetriggers=1 launch option, the steering is on the L stick, and the R stick will directly control the turret aim.
 When using the alternate gamepad scheme, the info-graphic of the gamepad is now properly labelled with the alternate controls.

notes.title: V104: Resume at last visited rock, and gamepad triggers.
notes.content:
Ring Miner v104 changes


 You can use gamepad triggers for throttle, if you add usetriggers=1 as a launch option in the steam menu.
 You now start a game session at the rock that you last visited.
